comment: The Returning-Customer Intake (Compass §15 / OD-14, CD ratified 2026-07-15). LOCAL-ONLY: answers live in localStorage (bardo_lives.intake), are NEVER transmitted, NEVER enter the Ledger, and are only ever string-substituted (no runtime LLM). OTHER is free text — the ratified exception to buttons-only — sanitized and length-capped by the engine, rendered via textContent. Questions are light PREFERENCES only: never identity, PII, or how-you-died. Each answer becomes a {value} injected at the node named in `injections`; changed answers across surveys are noted with a gentle favoring of variety (curiosity).
intro:
Returning customers are entitled to a more personalized experience.
It is in the charter. The charter is also me.

A few questions, then — nothing that matters, which is exactly
why your answers matter. Press a button, skip, or say it in
your own words. Nothing you type here leaves this machine; the
desk would not know where to send it.
other_prompt: In your own words (a word or two):

questions.prompt: It is a hot day. Genuinely too hot. You reach for —
Right now, given a choice, you would rather be —
A sound you love more than you can defend —
One thing you would happily return to forever —
Your weather — the kind that makes you most yourself —

options.label: A GREEN LIGHT ON THE FIRST TRY
options.value: a green light on the first try

questions.prompt: An animal you would, on balance, trust —
A word you overuse and have made peace with —

a2_light.line: You told the desk you would rather be {value}. The light has noticed, and is — even now — doing a quiet impression of {value}. Badly. It is a light, not a set designer.

b1_beverage_cart.line: As a soul who, on a genuinely too-hot day, reaches for {value}: the cart has thoughts about that. It keeps them to itself. Professional discretion, and also it is a cart.

e1_reciprocity.line: You once named a sound you love: {value}. I have been running it, very low, under this whole confession. You did not notice — which is the kindest thing {value} has ever done for anyone.

f0_disclosure.line: You said you would return forever to {value}. That is the entire trick, you know — a thing you would choose again with your eyes open, knowing the cost. Keep hold of whatever taught you that.

outro.base: Filed. You are now, on paper, more yourself than the soul who last sat in this chair. The paper is me. I will carry it about eight minutes.
outro.unchanged_all: Every answer, exactly as before. Consistency. The desk finds it restful, and very slightly worrying, in the way that anything perfectly unchanging is.
outro.changed_prefix: One or two things moved since last time:
outro.changed_suffix: The second pass favored something new. The desk approves, quietly, of a soul that surprises it — variety is only curiosity wearing a change of clothes, and curiosity is the one thing this place cannot fake for you.
